newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends up 22 cents on technical rebound.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends up 22 cents on technical rebound.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed up 22 cents at 14.70 ringgit ($5.82) a kg in a technical bounce after a 32 cent drop on Monday, traders said.
"The market ignored an overnight fall in London as yesterday's drop here was overdone," said a trader. Tin price on the London Metal Exchange (LME) fell $70 on Monday.
Traders noted initial bids of 220 tonnes against offers of 98 tonnes. Final turnover was 108 tonnes, down from Monday's 124 tonnes, and were absorbed by European and local interests.
The trader said further correction is likely on Wednesday though another sharp drop in LME could limit gains.
The local price is now at a premium of $80 a tonne over LME, against a discount of $85 on Monday, following the rebound here and overnight fall in London, traders said.
